title: Zero-Dependency Reactive Task & Pomodoro Engine
brief: Build a modular vanilla ES2024 task board and focus timer using Proxy-based reactive state, Event Delegation, AbortController cleanup, localStorage persistence, debounced search filtering, and a clean immutable reducer layer.

requirements.text: Implement a Proxy-backed reactive store that notifies subscribers automatically when state updates.
Handle all task list clicks (toggle complete, delete, edit) with a single delegated event listener using event.target.closest().
Implement a reusable debounce() utility for live task search filtering.
Use AbortController to cancel pending async quote fetches and detach window keyboard shortcuts cleanly.
Use ES2023 immutable array helpers (toSorted, filter, map) and persist tasks cleanly to localStorage with safe JSON error handling.
Build an accurate drift-corrected Pomodoro timer using Date.now() deltas and clean teardown.

steps.title: Create Reactive Proxy Store
steps.details: Build store.js wrapping state in a Proxy + Reflect.set that dispatches subscriber callbacks cleanly.

steps.title: Write Pure Task Reducers
steps.details: Implement pure addTask, toggleTask, deleteTask, and filterTasks helpers using immutable array patterns.

steps.title: Build Delegated DOM Renderer
steps.details: Render task rows via DocumentFragment + textContent (zero innerHTML XSS) and bind one delegated listener.

steps.title: Add Debounced Search & Keyboard Shortcuts
steps.details: Wire debounce(render, 150) on the search input and register Ctrl+K shortcut using AbortController.

steps.title: Build Drift-Free Timer
steps.details: Compute remaining milliseconds from targetEndTime - Date.now() instead of trusting setInterval drift.

steps.title: Persist & Verify Edge Cases
steps.details: Load/save safely with try/catch around localStorage and test empty, invalid, and rapid-click states.
